AttachmentOut.description:
`url` downloads it (`?inline=1` shows raster images in the page). `mime` is what
the content is, whatever the upload declared.
AttachmentOut.title: AttachmentOut

AuditOut.description: `actor_name`: the acting person's display name (None for other principals).
AuditOut.title: AuditOut

ChannelUpdate.description: Fields left out stay as they are; null clears the topic. A name cannot be null.
ChannelUpdate.title: ChannelUpdate

ConversationOut.description:
`can_post`: whether the caller may write here now (the right in the space, and
the channel not archived). `created_by` is null for what the system set up.
`version` guards writes (send it back; stale → 409). A direct message lists its
`participants` and, on its own (`GET /conversations/{id}`), every admin
`inspections` of it; both are empty for other kinds.
ConversationOut.title: ConversationOut

DiffOut.description:
Line by line from `from_number` to `to_number`; a changed line is a `delete`
followed by an `insert`.
DiffOut.title: DiffOut

DirectoryEntryOut.description: Who can be added to a space. Deliberately no email or role: any member may read it.
DirectoryEntryOut.title: DirectoryEntryOut

DmOpen.description: The other people (the caller is added); 2 to 9 people in all.
DmOpen.title: DmOpen

DmOut.description:
A direct message in the caller's list: `last_message_at` is its newest
top-level message (null before the first).
DmOut.title: DmOut

GroupMemberIn.description: People only in M1; agents join in M6.
GroupMemberIn.title: GroupMemberIn

ImportResultOut.description: `created`: pages, folders without a file of their own included.
ImportResultOut.title: ImportResultOut

InspectableDmOut.description: What an inspecting admin learns before an inspection: who, and when, no content.
InspectableDmOut.title: InspectableDmOut

InspectionNoteOut.description: An admin looked into this direct message (spec 5.5): when, and who.
InspectionNoteOut.title: InspectionNoteOut

InspectionOut.description: Read the DM's messages at `/admin/dm-inspect/{id}/messages` until `expires_at`.
InspectionOut.title: InspectionOut

MeOut.description:
`permissions`: the system-wide actions the caller holds; clients decide what to
show from these (and from a space's `my_role`), never from the role's name.
MeOut.title: MeOut

MessageCreate.description:
`parent_id`: a top-level message of the same conversation, to reply in its
thread. `client_id`: the client's key for this message; sending again with the
same key returns the first message (200) instead of a second one. `mentions`:
whom the text mentions (`@[Name](user:<id>)`); at most 50.

mentions.description: the people the message mentions (user ids)
mentions.title: Mentions

MessageCreate.title: MessageCreate

MessageOut.description:
`author` is null for system messages. A deleted message keeps its place with
`deleted_at` set and an empty `body_md`. `reply_count` and `last_reply_at` belong
to top-level messages (their thread). `mentions`: the people mentioned who may see
the conversation; `reactions`: by emoji, the first reacted with first.
MessageOut.title: MessageOut

MessageUpdate.description: `mentions` left out: the message keeps whom it mentions; given: replaces it.

anyOf.description: the people the message mentions (user ids)

MessageUpdate.title: MessageUpdate

MessageWriteOut.description:
`not_notified`: the mentioned ids that were not stored: people who may not see
the conversation, and ids of nobody (indistinguishable on purpose).
MessageWriteOut.title: MessageWriteOut

PageMove.description:
`parent_id` null: the top level. `position` among the new siblings, 0 first;
left out: at the end, or where the page is if its parent stays.
PageMove.title: PageMove

PageOut.description:
`version` guards writes (send it back; stale → 409). `collab_generation` changes
whenever open live-editing sessions of the page end. `tags`: tag ids, by name.
PageOut.title: PageOut

PageUpdate.description: Fields left out stay as they are; neither may be null.
PageUpdate.title: PageUpdate

ParticipantOut.description: A person in a direct message; one who was deactivated stays listed.
ParticipantOut.title: ParticipantOut

PasswordChangeIn.description: A person's own new password; the current one proves it is them.
PasswordChangeIn.title: PasswordChangeIn

ReactionOut.description: People who reacted with `emoji`; `mine`: the caller among them.
ReactionOut.title: ReactionOut

SearchHitOut.description:
`snippet` is plain text: render it as text and highlight what stands between
`⟦` and `⟧`. `score` orders the hits (higher is better); it has no unit.
SearchHitOut.title: SearchHitOut

SkippedOut.description:
`path`: the entry's name in the archive. `reason`: unsafe_path, not_markdown,
exists, duplicate, too_deep, too_large, invalid_text, unreadable, no_page, or why an
attachment was refused (type_not_allowed, type_mismatch, filename_invalid).
SkippedOut.title: SkippedOut

SpaceCreate.description: `personal` is a valid kind but not one the API creates (422 spaces.kind_not_allowed).
SpaceCreate.title: SpaceCreate

SpaceMemberOut.description: `name`: the person's or group's display name.
SpaceMemberOut.title: SpaceMemberOut

SpaceOut.description: `my_role` is the caller's role there, for display (system admins: `admin`).
SpaceOut.title: SpaceOut

SpaceRole.description:
A role inside one space, ordered `viewer < editor < moderator < admin` (by rank,
not alphabetically, so `max()` gives the strongest).
SpaceRole.title: SpaceRole

SystemRole.description: A person's organisation-wide role. There is always at least one active owner.
SystemRole.title: SystemRole

TagCreate.description:
Without `space_id` a system-wide tag (`tag.manage`); with one, a tag of that
space (`page.moderate` there).
TagCreate.title: TagCreate

TagUpdate.description: Fields left out stay as they are; neither may be null. A tag keeps its scope.
TagUpdate.title: TagUpdate

TagsSet.description:
The object's tags from now on (the set replaces the old one); `version` is the
page version the client read.
TagsSet.title: TagsSet

TrashedPageOut.description:
A page that went into the trash on its own or with the pages below it; `path`
and `parent_id` are where it was.
TrashedPageOut.title: TrashedPageOut

TreeNodeOut.description:
A page in the flat tree: nest by `parent_id`, order siblings by `sort_order`.
`tags`: tag ids, by name.
TreeNodeOut.title: TreeNodeOut

UnreadOut.description:
`unread`: others' top-level messages after the read position (not deleted);
`mentions`: mentions of the caller after it, in threads too.
UnreadOut.title: UnreadOut

UserUpdateIn.description: The PATCH body: the changes plus the version the client read.
UserUpdateIn.title: UserUpdateIn

VersionAuthor.description: `name` is None for an author that is not a person.
VersionAuthor.title: VersionAuthor

VersionSummaryOut.description:
`change_summary` is free text, or `restore:<n>` for a version that brought
version n back (the client words it).
VersionSummaryOut.title: VersionSummaryOut

app__modules__wiki__schemas__ExpectedVer.description: The page version the client read (stale → 409 `page.version_conflict`).
app__modules__wiki__schemas__ExpectedVer.title: ExpectedVersion
